description: This Java source file defines the `ImmutableTargetMetrics` class, which is an immutable implementation of the `TargetMetrics` interface. It provides methods to create instances, convert to/from JSON, and retrieve address metrics related to connectivity targets within the Eclipse Ditto modeling framework.

classes.name: ImmutableTargetMetrics
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the TargetMetrics interface, representing metrics associated with connectivity targets. Offers JSON serialization/deserialization and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableTargetMetrics instance from a map of address metrics.

methods.name: getAddressMetrics
methods.description: Returns the map of address metrics.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject, applying a predicate filter.

methods.name: addressMetricsToJson
methods.description: Converts the addressMetrics map to a JsonObject.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableTargetMetrics instance from a JsonObject representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on addressMetrics.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
